scope: Bounded title/abstract/reason review of keyword-selected main-view records. No full-text or comprehensive corpus audit; no production records changed. User requested caveats rather than wholesale re-estimation.
rules: pipeline/rubric.md v0.3.4 excludes extracting leakage but includes mathematical attacks with abstract hints and speed-focused implementations of mathematical solvers.
interpretation: These counts are weighted items, not person-years; deleting a record can change an author publication-share denominator and smoothing, so there is no valid direct item-to-FTE subtraction.
The existing leakage flag is incomplete; its 39 flagged main records cannot provide a comprehensive no-leakage sensitivity estimate.

This review does not establish that contamination is globally small. It found little direct evidence of pure implementation leakage extraction in the selected records, but material scope/attribution ambiguities remain.

Suggested site text: We exclude implementation-only attacks such as timing, power analysis and fault injection. Our broader research corpus still includes mathematical attacks supplied with partial information, special-case instances and shared algorithmic tools; it is not a count of attacks directly applicable to deployed schemes. Classification and attribution errors remain possible.
recommended_next_audit_steps: Review the single HAWK/LIP scope mismatch against the current rubric before adding a focused manual exclusion.
Review HNP/ECDSA class attribution and mixed-thesis effort fractions.
Complete leakage flags before reporting a no-hints sensitivity view.

If canonical exclusions are approved, rerun analysis/export_combined.py, analysis/phase1_counts.py, analysis/author_map.py, paper/generate_tables.py and pipeline/build_site_data.py using each script’s documented prerequisites; do not subtract paper counts directly from author-years.

evidence.title: The Lattice Isomorphism Problem with Hints
evidence.audit_reason: The main target is HAWK/LIP, expressly excluded by rubric v0.3.4. An SVP embedding does not establish generic LWE/MLWE attack applicability. Recommend excluding from headline assumption corpus while retaining it in the separate HAWK comparison corpus.
evidence.current_label_reason: LIP-with-hints SVP embedding; intrinsic signature hints cut Hawk-1024 security ~11 bits.

evidence.title: Attacking ECDSA Leaking Discrete Bits with a More Efficient Lattice
evidence.audit_reason: Title and existing reason concern ECDSA nonce leakage / HNP, not direct ECDLP. Abstract is absent. Review 0.5 ECDLP attribution; do not automatically remove transferable lattice machinery.
evidence.current_label_reason: More efficient lattice for HNP with leaked ECDSA nonce bits; solving under hints.

evidence.title: Solving HNP with One Bit Leakage: An Asymmetric Lattice Sieving Algorithm
evidence.audit_reason: Abstract describes HNP from nonce leakage and an asymmetric lattice-sieving algorithm. Review 0.5 ECDLP attribution; lattice method may remain relevant.
evidence.current_label_reason: Asymmetric sieving algorithm solving HNP with 1-bit nonce leakage.

evidence.title: Improved Attacks on (EC)DSA with Nonce Leakage by Lattice Sieving with Predicate
evidence.audit_reason: Abstract concerns HNP from nonce leakage and sieving-with-predicate improvements. Review 0.4 ECDLP attribution; transferable lattice method may remain relevant.
evidence.current_label_reason: Improved sieving-with-predicate for HNP from (EC)DSA nonce leakage; new lattice records.

evidence.title: Improved Attacks Against Lattice-Based KEMs Using Hints From Hertzbleed
evidence.audit_reason: Main contribution exploits existing modular hints with low-dimensional lattices, which rubric allows, but abstract also says additional hints are extracted. A closer read is needed before assigning any exclusion fraction.
evidence.current_label_reason: Better use of modular hints via low-dimensional lattices for key recovery; hint exploitation.

evidence.title: Mathematical and physical concerns regarding cryptographic key length
evidence.audit_reason: Thesis includes hardware ECDLP record and key-length models, but also fault attacks and fuzzy extractors. Whole-thesis effort need not belong entirely to the mathematical-assumption corpus.
evidence.current_label_reason: Thesis on key-length models with hardware ECDLP attack cost data point.

evidence.title: Discrete Logarithm Cryptanalyses : Number Field Sieve and Lattice Tools for Side-Channel Attacks. (Cryptanalyses de logarithmes discrets : crible algébrique et réseaux pour canaux auxiliaires)
evidence.audit_reason: Thesis combines TNFS complexity and an actual 521-bit finite-field DLP record with side-channel lattice tools. Legitimate mathematical component; review attribution and possible duplicate W7027626139.
evidence.current_label_reason: Thesis: NFS/TNFS complexity, 521-bit DL record, lattice tools for exponent leakage.

evidence.title: Cryptanalyses de logarithmes discrets : crible algébrique et réseaux pour canaux auxiliaires
evidence.audit_reason: Same French thesis title and matching abstract content as dblp:phd/hal/Micheli21; possible duplicate with differing attribution. Not a reason to exclude the legitimate TNFS component.
evidence.current_label_reason: Thesis: TNFS complexity, 521-bit TNFS record DL, plus lattice side-channel work.

evidence.title: LWE with Side Information: Attacks and Concrete Security Estimation
evidence.audit_reason: Framework mathematically integrates hints into primal LWE attacks. Intentionally included by current leakage rubric, but not evidence of progress on an instance without extra information. Leakage flag is absent.
evidence.current_label_reason: Framework integrating hints into primal lattice attacks with performance prediction toolkit.

evidence.title: On the Dual Attack of LWE Schemes in the Presence of Hints
evidence.audit_reason: Mathematical dual LWE attack framework given hints; current scope intentionally includes it. Leakage flag is absent.
evidence.current_label_reason: Fourier-analytic dual attack framework incorporating hints; estimates for Kyber768 and FireSaber.

evidence.title: Reducing an LWE Instance by Modular Hints and its Applications to Primal Attack, Dual Attack and BKW Attack
evidence.audit_reason: Mathematical transformation of LWE with modular hints; current scope intentionally includes it. Leakage flag is absent.
evidence.current_label_reason: Reduces LWE instances using modular hints; improves primal, dual and BKW attacks.

evidence.title: Solving LWE with Independent Hints about Secret and Errors
evidence.audit_reason: Mathematical method integrating secret/error hints; current scope intentionally includes it. Leakage flag is absent.
evidence.current_label_reason: Faster integration of secret and error hints into LWE lattice attacks.

evidence.title: Syndrome Decoding with Hints
evidence.audit_reason: ISD algorithm with abstract perfect/noisy hints; current scope intentionally includes it. Leakage flag is absent.
evidence.current_label_reason: ISD adapted to syndrome decoding with perfect/noisy hints; thresholds for polynomial-time regime.

evidence.title: Syndrome Decoding Under Posterior Leakage: Experimental and Theorical Analysis in Post-Quantum Cryptography : Comparative Analysis of Reed-Muller and Random Codes
evidence.audit_reason: Models cold-boot posterior information and studies guided decoding; abstract supports hint-exploitation rather than an experiment extracting physical leakage. Low-dimensional toy comparisons warrant quality caution, not keyword exclusion.
evidence.current_label_reason: Syndrome decoding given noisy cold-boot posteriors; decoding with hints.

evidence.title: ECDLP on GPU
evidence.audit_reason: GPU implementation speeds Pollard rho for ECDLP. Incidental remark that branchless routines also prevent side channels does not make the work out of scope.
evidence.current_label_reason: Branchless GPU implementation of parallel Pollard rho for ECDLP; attack speed.

evidence.title: Statistical Analysis of Pollard's Rho Attack on Elliptic Curve Cryptography
evidence.audit_reason: Statistical performance study of Pollard rho; side channels are background only. Weak evidence quality is distinct from mathematical scope.
evidence.current_label_reason: Statistical study of Pollard rho performance factors on ECDLP; weak.

evidence.title: Resilience of lattice-based Cryptosystems to Quantum Attacks
evidence.audit_reason: Quantum LWE solver experiments and proposed methodology. Mention of side channels does not dominate the contribution; full-paper quality assessment is separate.
evidence.current_label_reason: Testing quantum LWE solvers on reduced FIPS 203 keys; preliminary methodology.

evidence.title: Solving Linear Equations Modulo Unknown Divisors: Revisited
evidence.audit_reason: Abstract and reason emphasize Coppersmith/structured-RSA applications. Rubric now provides rsa_variant rather than generic factoring; review tag. Not a pure side-channel extraction paper.
evidence.current_label_reason: Coppersmith-style modular equation solving improving attacks on RSA variants.

evidence.title: On the Dangers of RSA Exponent Transforms
evidence.audit_reason: Weak public exponent / transformed exponent special cases, presently credited to factoring. Review rsa_variant tag; mathematical attack remains distinct from general factoring.
evidence.current_label_reason: Coppersmith/Blomer-May factoring given approximate multiple of phi(N); weak large exponents.
